data.sub: Chakravati toofan Akvan ka khatra, 90 km/h ki raftar se chalengi hawayein.

chat.say: Sir, kya kal school ki chhutti rahegi?
Bahar mat nikalna, chupchaap ghar pe baitho!

data.asar: Mausam kharab hai, bina wajah ghar se bahar na niklein.
data.caption:
Chakravati toofan 'Akvan' ka khatra mandra raha hai! 🌪️

• 90 km/ghanta ki raftar se chalengi tez hawayein
• Chhattisgarh mein toofan ka double attack, barish se bheega Raipur
• 11 jilon mein alert jari kiya gaya hai
• Suraksha ke chalte 3.72 lakh logon ko shift kiya gaya

Aapke ilake mein mausam kaisa hai? Comment mein batao aur doston ko alert karo!
